_provenance: Buoc 6 (2026-09-08). Hashes are CRLF-normalized (LF) SHA256 -- see VERIFY_UPSTREAM.ps1's Get-NormalizedSha256 and dsp_host_sim/VERIFY_UPSTREAM.ps1's identical function (same fix, same reason: environment-independent regardless of core.autocrlf). Detects drift in the common/ ABI headers libzmpio/zmpiod/zmpioctl assume without recompiling -- a change here means Buoc 6's build (BUILD_STEP.ps1) and Buoc 1-5's firmware must be rebuilt together.
